capabilities: apply bionic-reading bolding to notes in Reading mode
skip code blocks, inline code, and non-prose elements
run on both desktop and mobile
extras: Installation is manual only (copying release files into the plugins folder); no community plugin store install is described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render notes with Bionic Reading emphasis to make long text easier to read.
summary: Bionic Reading formatter that bolds word prefixes in Reading mode to create visual anchors for ADHD readers.
